title: The languages of the earth — PHOIBLE
body: The phonological inventory of the world's languages: each tongue's family, region, and the consonants, vowels and tones it speaks with. The scattering of Babel and the gathering of Pentecost, catalogued — a spine of the Floor of Discovery at the scale of human language.
subject: the languages of the earth
